Two years ago, I was a different person.

 

Not just physically – though going from size 8 to 18 was devastating enough.

 

I mean I was ALIVE. Coffee walks with friends. Weekend hikes. Dancing at my daughter's wedding without needing to sit every 10 minutes.

 

Then hypothyroidism hit like a freight train.

 

First came the exhaustion. Not tired – EXHAUSTION. Like someone replaced my blood with concrete.

 

Then the weight started piling on. But here's what made it truly insane:

 

The less I ate, the faster I gained.

 

Started at 1,500 calories – gained 15 pounds in 3 months.

 

Dropped to 1,200 calories – gained another 20 pounds.

 

Went down to 900 calories – gained 25 MORE pounds

 

My endocrinologist's response? "Your TSH is 2.5. That's perfect. Maybe try eating less processed food."

 

I was living on grilled chicken and steamed broccoli. What processed food?
settings.ggXcjld3Nx__text:
After 13 doctors and 2 years of gaslighting, I finally found Dr. Margaret Anne.

 

She didn't just listen – she EXPLAINED.

 

"Your doctors are only testing TSH and T4," she said. "But they're missing the whole story."

 

She drew me a diagram I'll never forget:

 

Here's what SHOULD happen:

 

Your thyroid makes T4 (inactive hormone)

 

Your body converts T4 to T3 (active hormone)

 

T3 unlocks your metabolism like keys in locks

 

You burn calories and have energy

 

Here's what's ACTUALLY happening with hypothyroidism:

 

Your thyroid makes T4 (or you take it as levothyroxine)

 

But stress, inflammation, and nutrient deficiencies cause your body to convert T4 to REVERSE T3 instead

 

Reverse T3 looks like T3 but doesn't work

 

These broken keys jam the locks

 

Real T3 can't get in

 

Your metabolism shuts down

 

"And here's the part that will make you angry," Dr. Margaret Anne continued.

 

"When you restrict calories severely – like your 900 calories – your body sees it as starvation stress. What does stress trigger? MORE Reverse T3 production."

 

I wanted to scream.

 

Every time I ate less to lose weight, I was literally making my body create MORE of the hormone that prevented weight loss.
